catalog.description: Hand-authored synthetic planar footprint for offline Geometry.bounds workflow validation.

planar_rectangle.method: Manual coordinate extrema; all four straight edges are axis-aligned.

high_latitude_line.method: The arc is symmetric around longitude 0. Its latitude extremum is where the great-circle tangent is east-west; use phi=75 degrees and deltaLongitude=120 degrees.

high_latitude_polygon.method: Analytically evaluate each minor great-circle edge's interior latitude extrema and endpoints; the closing edge has the same northern extremum as the line reference. The small polygon contains no pole and does not cross the antimeridian.

tolerances.wire_json: Exact byte hashes are recorded in the audit manifest; explicit-null controls retain each SDK's native serialization.
